SELECT dtt.driver_id AS driverId, d.name AS driverName, dtt.truck_type_id AS truckTypeId, tt.type_name AS truckTypeName, dtt.create_time AS createTime, dtt.update_time AS updateTime FROM driver_truck_type dtt JOIN driver d ON dtt.driver_id = d.id JOIN truck_type tt ON dtt.truck_type_id = tt.id
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{driverName}, '%')
AND tt.id = #{truckTypeId}
ORDER BY dtt.create_time DESC
